title: Joule Design Study
description: Three design directions for the Joule app (Conversation first, Control tower, Canvas) built on the Werkbank design system. Each shows five functions: value cockpit, flight recorder, opportunity radar, test arena and a proactive, hands-free Joule.
insights: Switch between a customer product owner (one tenant) and an SAP product owner (all tenants): the same five functions answer different questions.
Direction A puts the conversation first, B is a dense control tower, C is a spatial canvas of sources, opportunities, agents and systems.
The flight recorder replays one run step by step, including the approval that was asked and the action that the work profile blocked.
The test arena blocks publishing while a safety case fails; apply the fix and re-run to see the gates change.
Fictional sample data. Nothing is connected, no microphone is used, and several functions are concepts that are not built yet (see Compare and build path).
prompt: Bundled example: Joule Design Study (static mockup, data embedded by npm run sync:mockups).
